text: Jeonbuk State is Jeonbuk Special Self-Governing Province, the provincial-level local government of South Korea based in Jeonju; it is one of Jeonbuk Hyundai's 2026 uniform partners.
short: Jeonbuk State is South Korea's Jeonbuk Special Self-Governing Province.

source.name: Jeonbuk State official English website (JEONBUK STATE, Provincial Government section)
source.quote: the Governor of Jeonbuk State, Lee Won-taeg
source.note: The site's navigation reads 'About Jeonbuk State' and 'Provincial Government'; the Korean homepage styles itself '전북특별자치도 대표 누리집' (official website of Jeonbuk Special Self-Governing Province) with the footer 'ⓒ 2024 JEONBUK STATE', address 225 Hyoja-ro, Wansan-gu, Jeonju. Page undated.

additionalSources.quote: 세계식량계획(WFP), 금호타이어, 현대차 증권, 네이버 치지직, 전북특별자치도에 '모베드(MobED)'까지 추가됐다
additionalSources.note: Lists Jeonbuk Special Self-Governing Province (전북특별자치도) among the club's 2026 uniform partners.
